div.head: Episc 13
div.ab: Hit bið ælces hlafordes agen þearf, þæt he his nydþeowum byrge, swa he betst mæge, for ðam þe hy syn Gode efen leofe ⁊ þa ðe syndon freolse, ⁊ us ealle he gebohte mid gelican weorðe.
It is the responsibility of every lord to protect his slaves as best he can, for they are loved by God as much as those who are free, and he bought us all for the same price.

Uniuscuiusque domini proprium est necesse, ut seruis suis (compatiatur et) condescendat, sicut melius (indulgentius) poterit; quia domino Deo (uiuenti) sunt eque cari seruus et liber, et omnes redemit uno (eodem) precio.
